How it works

What this pack covers

  • A.2 Forces and momentum, SL and HL: Newton's three laws, free-body diagrams and equilibrium, friction and drag, springs, tension and buoyancy, momentum, impulse and circular motion.
  • Eight stages, one for each station of a skydive over the Palm. The scene drops from 4000 m to the beach as you move through them.

Mini-lessons

  • Every part has a task: predict, drag, sort, label a figure or run a simulation. The tasks are optional: move freely with Next, Back or the dots, in any order.
  • Nothing is marked until you press Check. After two tries on a drag task you can ask to be shown the answer.

Progress checks

  • Six questions in IB style: two at AO1 (state, define), two at AO2 (calculate, apply) and two at AO3 (explain, deduce, in an unfamiliar context).
  • The worked answer appears after each one. 5 or 6 right: Secure. 3 or 4: Nearly there. 0 to 2: Revisit.
  • A new check draws different questions, and calculation questions change their numbers each time.
  • Take g = 9.8 N kg⁻¹. Answers may be typed with or without units, in standard form if you like (3.2e4 or 3.2 × 10⁴).

Saving

  • Your progress is saved in this browser on this device. No name or log-in is needed.
  • Clearing the browser data, or using another device, starts afresh.
